$note: 父母宮（2026-10-12）：七殺.父母。《深造講義》下篇 宮垣論 父母宮 p.575–595。父母存亡、刑剋、孝服、灾病、偏房繼室所生、父有外遇、重拜父母一類斷語不用；天巫、天刑、天壽、白虎丧门等引擎冇嘅星不用；要分日夜生、廟陷嘅條文暫不用。原書父母宮兼論上司，呢部份照用。

rules.text: 七殺見〔煞〕，你和父母有代溝，和上司也容易不和。
rules.en: Qi Sha meets 〔harsh stars〕: there is a generation gap with your parents, and friction with bosses.

source.quote: 七杀守父母宫，煞轻者，主有代沟

rules.text: 七殺會紫微化權，你的父母成見很深，不易被說服。
rules.en: Qi Sha meets Zi Wei in Authority: your parents hold very fixed views and are hard to persuade.

source.quote: 七杀会紫微化权，父母成见极深

rules.text: 會紫微化科又見〔吉〕，父母有聲譽，只是兩代關係未必相諧。
rules.en: Meeting Zi Wei in Recognition with 〔helpful stars〕, your parents are well regarded, though the generations do not always see eye to eye.

rules.text: 七殺會到｛祿權科｝，你得到父母蔭庇之力。
rules.en: Qi Sha meeting ｛Abundance, Authority or Recognition｝: you benefit from your parents' shelter.

rules.text: 同宮有｛火星或鈴星｝，你與父母遠離。
rules.en: With ｛Huo Xing or Ling Xing｝ in the palace, you live far from your parents.

was.text: 同宮有火鈴，或會天馬，你與父母遠離。
was.en: With Huo Xing or Ling Xing in the palace, or meeting Tian Ma, you live far from your parents.

rules.text: 天馬會照父母宮，你多與父母遠離。
rules.en: With Tian Ma meeting your Parents Palace, you tend to live far from your parents.
rules.edit: 父母.七殺.遠 拆出嚟（2026-10-14 「或」填實）：原文「或」嘅另一半，條件唔同類，分開先填得實

rules.text: 七殺在父母宮，你與父母的關係較疏遠。
rules.en: With Qi Sha in your Parents Palace, your relationship with your parents is more distant.
